title: Futures book construction with correlations, walk-forward selection

candidates.MV50 / MV80: w ~ inv(S_shrunk) mu, S shrunk 50% / 80% toward its diagonal, negatives set to 0, normalised
candidates.HRP: hierarchical risk parity (Lopez de Prado 2016), correlation distance, single linkage
candidates.SWC: Sharpe-weighted divided by (1 + mean correlation with the other sleeves)

selection: weights fitted on 2010-06..2017-12, scored by book Sharpe on 2018-22 (10% vol target as now)
judgement: chosen method refitted on 2010-06..2022-12; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 0.842; adopt only if higher
